caveat: These are proposed studies derived from the current Method 1 synthesis; they are research designs for future work, not accepted claims, and not product-bound evidence. A linked record denotes evidence the source basis attaches to a statement, at the stance indicated, not endorsement of the proposed hypothesis. Method 1's confidence scale is internal and is not comparable across methods.
policy: prior-evidence links are real arXiv records from the local ledger; malformed URLs normalized; absent evidence marked unlinked; no invented papers/DOIs/IDs/numeric results; product claim/cite markers 0

proposals.title: A causal test of whether active galactic nucleus feedback suppresses star formation
proposals.question: At fixed stellar mass and environment, do AGN-hosting galaxies exhibit a measurable star-formation deficit attributable to feedback energetics rather than to shared mass or environment?
proposals.open_question: Whether a mass-, redshift-, and morphology-matched population exhibits a star-formation deficit attributable to AGN energetics, and which gas phase — the molecular reservoir or the replenishing inflow — responds.
data_plan: SDSS-MaNGA or MUSE integral-field spectroscopy: spatially resolved star-formation histories and gas kinematics around the nucleus (the response).
ALMA CO: molecular gas mass and depletion time (the fuel).
Chandra and XMM-Newton: X-ray luminosity and AGN mechanical/radiative power (the energy budget).
VLA and LOFAR: jet power and radio duty cycle (the kinetic channel).
proposals.test: Compare resolved star-formation suppression and molecular gas fraction between matched AGN and non-AGN control samples as a function of AGN power and mode.
proposals.decision: A calibrated star-formation deficit at fixed mass and environment, accompanied by an energy budget sufficient (or demonstrably insufficient) to drive it, thereby promoting or bounding the causal statement.
proposals.provenance: Source basis: claim 2929 (non-committal); kinetic mode 2915; rapid-quenching channel 2913.

proposals.title: Locating the regime in which internal and environmental quenching separate
proposals.question: At fixed stellar mass, does local environment contribute a measurable quenching excess beyond internal processes, and in which mass–redshift regime do the two channels separate rather than remain degenerate?
proposals.open_question: Which combination of stellar mass, redshift, and environment renders the channels separable, and whether satellite-versus-central status is the controlling variable.
data_plan: SDSS and GAMA: low-redshift group and cluster environment with quenched fractions.
COSMOS/CANDELS with JWST: environment at cosmic noon.
DESI: large mass- and redshift-matched parent samples (the denominator).
Euclid and Rubin (LSST): wide-area environment and weak-lensing halo mass.
proposals.test: Hold stellar mass fixed and vary environment (and conversely); measure the environmental quenching excess at fixed mass as a function of redshift.
proposals.decision: A separation map delineating the mass–redshift–environment regime in which an environmental quenching excess is detectable at fixed mass.
proposals.provenance: Source basis: claim 2931 (debated); satellite quenching 2934; environment–morphology 2932.

proposals.title: An observed heating-versus-cooling balance for maintenance quenching
proposals.question: In massive haloes, does AGN heating balance radiative cooling closely and frequently enough to maintain quiescence when measured observationally, rather than inferred from simulations alone?
proposals.open_question: The observed frequency and time-averaged sufficiency of heating relative to cooling across a mass-selected population, as opposed to individual cavity systems.
data_plan: Chandra: X-ray cavities and their mechanical power.
XMM-Newton and eROSITA: hot-halo thermodynamics and cooling luminosity.
VLA and LOFAR: radio-mode AGN duty cycle.
IllustrisTNG- and HORIZON-AGN-style simulations: forward-modelled predictions to be tested, explicitly labelled as simulations.
proposals.test: Measure cavity heating power against cooling luminosity across a mass-selected sample and compare the observed balance and duty cycle with the simulation predictions.
proposals.decision: An observational bound on the frequency with which heating balances cooling, converting a model expectation into a measured prevalence or refuting it.

proposals.title: A prioritised evidence-gap programme for the narrative-only sections
proposals.question: Which components of the galaxy-evolution narrative currently carry no directly attached evidence in the source basis, and in what order should named surveys ground them?
proposals.open_question: Which under-evidenced section is most tractable to ground first, and the expected evidence yield of each candidate survey per section.
data_plan: DESI: spectroscopy for gas, metallicity, and environment.
SDSS legacy: statistical baselines.
Euclid and Rubin: scale and large-scale structure.
JWST: the high-redshift and reionization frontier.
proposals.test: Score each thematic section by current evidential support and by the estimated yield of each candidate survey, producing a ranked observational programme.
proposals.decision: A reusable evidence-gap ranking that converts narrative-only sections into a defined data-collection order.
proposals.provenance: Source basis: per-section coverage record (two of nine sections directly evidenced).

proposals.title: Robustness of the synthesis to evidence accounting (methods appendix)
proposals.question: Do the synthesis's qualitative conclusions change when support is counted by distinct study rather than by record, and when incompletely catalogued references are resolved?
proposals.open_question: Whether any statement's confidence level shifts under distinct-study counting, and how sensitively interpretation depends on the unresolved references.
data_plan: The synthesis's existing literature corpus (no new observations).
NASA ADS and the local bibliography: metadata resolution only, explicitly not observational evidence.
proposals.test: Recompute per-statement support on a distinct-study basis, resolve the identifier-only references, and compare against the record-based tally.
proposals.decision: A methods-appendix result establishing whether the conclusions are stable under evidence-accounting choices, with a corrected distinct-study support level per statement.
proposals.provenance: Source basis: evidence tabulation (record-versus-study counts; identifier-only references).

proposals.title: Pre-registered acceptance criteria for AGN-feedback conclusions (methods appendix)
proposals.question: What explicit observational thresholds would justify promoting an AGN-feedback statement from tentative to established?
proposals.open_question: The quantitative thresholds — independent-study support, observation-versus-simulation mix, effect size, and consistency — that should gate promotion.
data_plan: The combined observational programmes of RP-1, RP-2, and RP-3 as the inputs a promotion decision would draw on (proposed evidence to gather).
NASA ADS and local corpus: independent-study counting only.
proposals.test: Specify thresholds and apply them retrospectively to the current AGN-feedback statements to determine which would promote, hold, or demote.
proposals.decision: A reproducible acceptance rule set adoptable by other syntheses, reducing subjective confidence judgements.
proposals.provenance: Source basis: AGN feedback & quenching section (statements 2929 non-committal, 2946 reported).
